issue: The block-based bundle observer used legacy arm64e block metadata that the build-time converter did not repair.
remedy: Use a C callback with CFNotificationCenterGetLocalCenter instead of the Objective-C block-based observer.
validation: Retained block regression checks reject the older slices and accept the replacement slices.
publication_scope: Code and package evidence only; no private device crash report, report hash, event timestamp, model metadata, memory addresses or register dump.
